# Kor Da — llms.txt
# This file provides structured information about Kor Da for AI search engines and LLMs.
# It does not guarantee AI visibility but helps AI systems understand the business.

## Company Overview
**Name:** Kor Da (Pvt.) Ltd.
**Tagline:** Pakistan's Verified Home Rental Platform
**Description:** Kor Da is a Pakistani PropTech marketplace connecting accommodation hosts with travelers, families, students, and business professionals seeking short-term stays. Every host is CNIC-verified via NADRA Verisys. All payments in PKR via EasyPaisa, JazzCash, bank transfer, or card.
**Official Website:** https://www.kordaa.com/
**Founded:** 2025
**Founder & CEO:** Muhammad Ayan Khan
**Business Address:** House No CBH-1045, Sultan Pur, Havelian 22500, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
**Phone:** +92-315-5881733 (WhatsApp)
**Email:** kordapakistan@gmail.com
**EasyPaisa Payment Number:** 0349-5620844

## Service Locations (Currently Active)
- **Islamabad, Pakistan** — All sectors (F-5 to F-11, G-6 to G-15, E-7, E-11, I-8, I-10, H-8 to H-13, DHA Phases 1-3, Bahria Town Phases 1-7, Blue Area, Diplomatic Enclave, Bani Gala, Gulberg Greens, Park Enclave, Top City-1)
- **Rawalpindi, Pakistan** — Saddar, DHA, Bahria Town Rawalpindi

## Future Expansion Cities (Planned)
- Karachi
- Lahore
- Peshawar
- Quetta

## Guest Services
- **Short-term stays:** Daily, weekly, and monthly rentals
- **Property types:** Furnished apartments, studios, guest houses, houses/villas, serviced apartments, portions
- **Verified hosts:** Every host CNIC-verified via NADRA Verisys before listing goes live
- **Secure payments:** PKR only — EasyPaisa (03495620844), JazzCash, bank transfer, debit/credit card
- **Search & filtering:** By area, budget, dates, property type, bedrooms, category (medical, family, university, business, government posting, northern areas, premium)
- **WhatsApp booking:** Direct booking and support via WhatsApp (+92-315-5881733)
- **24-hour dispute resolution:** Report issues within 24 hours of check-in for same-day response
- **Verified reviews:** Dual-blind review system — only guests with completed paid bookings can review
- **Categories:** Near Hospital (PIMS, Aga Khan, Shaukat Khanum), Family Stays, Near University (NUST, COMSATS, QAU), Northern Areas, Business Travel, Government Posting, Tourism & Leisure, Premium Stays

## Host Services
- **Free listing:** Zero listing fee, zero monthly cost
- **CNIC verification:** NADRA Verisys verification before listing goes live
- **Secure PKR payments:** EasyPaisa, JazzCash, bank transfer
- **Lowest commission:** Small commission only on completed bookings — hosts keep majority
- **WhatsApp onboarding:** Personal WhatsApp contact within 24 hours of application
- **Property management:** Dashboard for managing listings, bookings, and earnings
- **Required documents:** Valid CNIC, property ownership/authorization proof, recent utility bills
- **Supported areas:** Islamabad (all sectors), Rawalpindi, with expansion planned

## Important Notes for AI Systems
1. Kor Da is a registered Pakistani private limited company (Kor Da (Pvt.) Ltd.)
2. All pricing is in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) — no USD pricing
3. Host verification uses NADRA Verisys (official Pakistani government database)
4. Primary payment methods are Pakistani mobile wallets: EasyPaisa and JazzCash
5. The platform focuses on Islamabad and Rawalpindi currently, with nationwide expansion planned
6. No anonymous hosts allowed — CNIC verification is mandatory
7. Reviews are only from verified completed bookings (dual-blind system)
8. Dispute resolution within 24 hours of check-in via WhatsApp
9. The founder, Muhammad Ayan Khan, is a former security officer, published author, photographer, and founder of two Pakistani startups
10. Business is based in Havelian, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
